sample_unit: clinical or research laboratory professionals (survey respondents)

links.outcome: Formal AI training received and willingness to take AI courses among laboratory professionals
links.effect: Only 4.7% had received formal AI training; 84.8% were willing to take AI courses; 74% cited lack of knowledge and training as a major concern.
links.quote: Only 4.7% of respondents had received formal AI training, but 84.8% were willing to take AI courses.

screen.reason: Survey of clinical and research laboratory professionals in Mexico assessing their conceptualization, familiarity, concerns, and barriers regarding AI implementation in laboratory medicine.
